item.title: Lotoha’apai strengthens lead with win over Navutoka in men's football league
item.description: Lotoha’apai strengthened its position at the top of the Men’s Premier Football League standings with a 5-0 victory over Navutoka on Saturday, 29 August 2026. The main match saw the current lead Lotoha’apai face a determined Navutoka side, which worked hard to defend its territory.
item.content:encoded:
Lotoha’apai strengthened its position at the top of the Men’s Premier Football League standings with a 5-0 victory over Navutoka on Saturday, 29 August 2026.

The main match saw the current lead Lotoha’apai face a determined Navutoka side, which worked hard to defend its territory.

However, Lotoha’apai’s attacking pressure eventually proved too strong, with the league leaders scoring five goals to secure another important win as the competition moves towards the finals.

Coaches said teams were continuing to fight for their positions on the ladder with the finals scheduled to be held in October.

Other matches played on Saturday included Veitongo against Longoteme, Nukuhetulu against Folaha, ‘Atata against Fahefa, Longolongo against Ha’ateiho, and Marist against Lapaha.

The league will be continuing throughout the coming weeks.
